responsibility: This header defines the baseline generic AArch64 tuning model and the reusable default cost tables that many other per-core tuning headers include. It provides generic address, register-move, branch, AdvSIMD, SVE, vector, approximation, and prefetch cost structures plus the `generic_tunings` `tune_params` bundle, making it the fallback microarchitectural model and the common source of default cost components for the rest of `tuning_models/`.
